title: Speaking at the event
subtitle: How was it from your side of the room?
intro: Thank you for speaking. You saw the parts of the event nobody else did — the green room, the tech, the schedule as it actually ran.
introDisclaimer: Anonymous. It is not tied to your session or your name, so say the awkward part.
introThankYou: This is how the speaker experience gets better.
thanksBody: Noted, and acted on where we can.

questions.prompt: Overall, how was speaking at the event?
How likely are you to submit again next year?
Communication before the event — deadlines, what to send, when
The speaker hub — uploading your deck, travel, hotel, the tasks
Your room and its technology on the day
Speaker hospitality — arrival, hotel, the appreciation dinner
Was your session slot the right length?
Did anything go wrong that we could have prevented?
questions.help: Technical, logistical, or organisational — we would rather hear it than not.

questions.prompt: If you could change ONE thing for speakers next year, what would it be?
